observed: All six plain/OpenAds sample UTM/Naver Premium sample UTM cases retain the same name/phone/message form with submit visible and no horizontal page overflow.
All four UTM cases retain all five supplied UTM values in aj_utm_* cookies, domain .blinkad.kr, Secure, SameSite Lax.
GTM-K2TTW7SV script returns HTTP 200 in all six cases. Automatic Google Analytics collect POSTs were attempted and blocked by the audit route; receipt and conversion reporting were not verified.
window.gtag is undefined at the recorded loaded state in all six cases.

Exact final-plan 10 URLs also pass HTTP 200, no redirect, visible same form and all four UTM cookie values match; OpenAds five desktop cases and Naver Premium five mobile cases. No application page errors. Campaign/content are exact planned values.

sourceFacts.fact: Default contact opens general free diagnosis modal automatically; source is fixed premium_content_contact.
Known Nest service/topic may select a different form; UTM-only does not select Nest.
Name and phone required by JavaScript; message optional; no store/business/service fields in default form. HTML required is absent.
Submission is programmed to POST name/phone/message/source/submittedAt plus tracking object; actual submission not tested.
Tracker captures five UTM values in 7200-second cookies.
Submission tracking includes utm_source/medium/campaign/content/term, referrer and landing.
GA client ID helper returns empty when window.gtag is not a function; loaded-state undefined was observed but actual inquiry payload was not sent.

limitations: No external platform post/click was tested; provided contact URL and audit UTM variants were loaded directly. Real referrer preservation from OpenAds/Naver was not measured.
No form input, submit, endpoint/CRM receipt, GA4 DebugView or conversion report checked. All non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS browser requests blocked to prevent writes.
No actual phone keyboard/mobile-device/assistive-technology usability test. Responsive Chromium desktop/mobile viewport rendering and screenshots checked.
Source is current local worktree only; browser confirms visible form/cookie behavior, not equality of all live JS bundles to local source.
